description: Bring that special someone (and maybe a light blanket) to enjoy a fun-mantic evening on the bay. Three couples will be chosen to compete for a chance to win a romantic fully paid night in Catalina Island! Create a great memory with chill music, spectacular views and the warmth of that special someone next to you. Special Valentine drink specials will be available. Limited seating to allow for a more intimate evening…so book now.
what_is_included:
💗 Relaxing evening cruise with stunning skyline views
💗 Drinks available for purchase
highlights:
💗 Gorgeous nighttime views of the San Diego skyline
💗 Classic tunes from iconic artists like Ella Fitzgerald and Sinatra
💗Chill ambiance with mood lighting and tranquil surroundings
check_in_details: 💗 All guests should plan to arrive to the Point Loma area 30 minutes prior to departure to allow for parking and walking to our marina. **Refunds will not be given for missed tours due to late arrivals.**
disclaimers:
💘 This is not a private charter. Other groups/people will be on board. Our boat holds 30 passengers, a minimum of eight passengers (all groups combined) is needed to operate. 
💘 **Absolutely no outside food or beverages permitted.**
💘 Photos and video will be taken throughout the cruise. By boarding the boat, you consent to your image being captured and used for promotional purposes.	
💘 If you or anyone in your group is found responsible for clogging or damaging the toilet on board, a $450 charge will be applied to your credit card. Such damage disrupts your tour, impacts all subsequent tours that day, and may require us to cancel operations.
faqs:
💗 **Weather Policy:** Tiki Time runs rain or shine. We only cancel if weather conditions are unsafe – high winds, strong currents, lightning and/or thunder. Captains are responsible for the safety of passengers and crew and will make the final decision. Guests will be notified one (1) hour prior to departure if Tiki Time needs to cancel. Full refunds will be issued if Tiki Time cancels.
💗 **Cancellation Policy:** Full refund if canceled 24 hours in advance. 
💘  **Last minute bookings**: Same day or next day reservations will be considered as **final sale**. No refunds or credits will be provided for cancelations.
